conf.description: FireEye EX ex-alert LEEF notification feed: header split + named key=value attribute decode, email attributes mapped into email.* ECS, keep _raw per no-masking direct-route decision.

conf.comment: fireeye / ex-alert / syslog-leef. Same header-split + lookahead attribute-tokenizer technique as sibling dm_fireeye_nx_alert_syslog_leef (delimiter tab or caret per site). One attachment hash (MD5), no per-attachment array -- headline attachment only, matching the CEF/JSON siblings. Unlike the sibling nx-alert LEEF pipeline, the LEEF header EventID field is NOT mapped to event.action here: the work order's field list for this dataset gives no header-derived action row at all (no CEF-style 'header name' field is documented for EX LEEF), so the nx-alert agent's by-analogy inference was deliberately not repeated -- left unmapped rather than compounding an unverified assumption (see README gaps). No act/disposition field is documented for LEEF either, so event.type is not populated on this transport (present on JSON and CEF, absent here -- a map gap, not a parser gap). devTime is parsed best-effort since no devTimeFormat row is supplied.

functions.description: split the 5 pipe-delimited LEEF header fields plus the trailing attribute blob (tolerates a leading syslog envelope since unanchored)
tokenize the named-key attribute blob, map every documented key to ECS/custom targets, best-effort devTime parse (no devTimeFormat row supplied), dataset/category tags, cleanup
Re-nest flat dotted keys (data-maps canonical step)
